semantic_findings.acceptance: A live active-root/dev-root mismatch is restart-worthy even when code and config are unchanged.
semantic_findings.evidence: root_split is initialized to 0, set to 1 only for a resolved active root unequal to DEV_ROOT, and participates in the restart condition.

semantic_findings.acceptance: Restart intent stays PID-bound and is recorded before SIGTERM.
semantic_findings.evidence: The existing watchdog --record-intent-pid/--record-intent-target call remains before kill -TERM, and failure to record intent exits without killing the process.

semantic_findings.acceptance: A matching active root with no code/config change remains a no-op.
semantic_findings.evidence: root_split remains 0 for ACTIVE_ROOT == DEV_ROOT and tests pass.

semantic_findings.acceptance: The hotfix is bounded to the two declared files.
semantic_findings.evidence: Net first-parent diff of merge 941c15a3 into dev contains only scripts/sync-dev-root.sh and scripts/test_sync_dev_root.py.

independent_review.notes: Code side passes: net first-parent diff of merge 941c15a3 into dev is exactly scripts/sync-dev-root.sh + scripts/test_sync_dev_root.py; root_split initialises to 0, is set to 1 only when the resolved ACTIVE_ROOT differs from DEV_ROOT, and is ORed into the restart condition.
